name: Mara's Threshold Heuristics
hypothesis: Previous mandatory deposit and rigid rest rules caused agents to stop prematurely or fail to harvest due to poor synchronization with food patch locations; this hypothesis posits that relaxing the deposit condition to only trigger when cargo exceeds capacity by 1 unit, combined with a dynamic rest interval based on remaining steps rather than fixed ticks, will maximize trips per 720 steps while preventing energy depletion.
